summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial is testing a combination of three lipid-lowering drugs, including bempedoic acid, in adults with acute coronary syndrome. Acute coronary syndrome is a condition caused by sudden blocked blood flow to the heart, such as a heart attack. The study is sponsored by Taipei Medical University Hospital and aims to enroll 400 participants. Researchers want to see how well these treatments lower cholesterol levels in the blood after 12 weeks.
